facts.fact: The Interior Ministry's circular n° 32 states the integrated revenue management platform GIR-CT was already deployed in 969 of 1,590 local authorities (collectivités territoriales), as of 19 May 2020.

The circular says the Walis and Governors steer revenue recovery through the GIR-Reporting system, and that the revenue offices (régies) of local authorities, including wholesale markets and abattoirs, are being dematerialised and integrated into the GIR-CT platform.

The circular, signed by the Minister of the Interior through the DGCT, directs authorising officers to equip their revenue offices with computers, printers, cheque readers and internet and to work with the Treasury (TGR) on the generalisation of GIR-CT.
